svg.text: A constant evolving ambient that thickens with the ladder; tonal cues in key; a motif that gains instruments per organelle.
Evolution · audio direction · build 1 (hooks now, assets later)
First ten minutes of a round (fast solo player, GAME-DESIGN §5.1 pace curve)
five stage stems crossfade upward; the pad ducks under every danger ring; bloom = full mix
short pitched pluck on a pentatonic note of the current stem key; 5 notes round-robin
harp-like upward glissando, 0.6 s, in key
the motif phrase played by the newest instrument (3 s); pick = a held chord
rising tonal swell + sub that tracks progress; resolves on the tonic at payout
pad ducks -8 dB and a low pulsing drone fades in while the ring is shown
the motif played descending, then the pad drops to the protocell stem for 3 s
re-entry chord swelling up; stem returns to your stage
a zone-coloured pad layer crossfades in over 2 s (see zones)
the full motif as a 20 s cadence; the winner's stem leads
bed -22 LUFS constant; cues peak -12 dBFS; eat cooldown 150 ms, max 4 eats/s audible
≈ 20–30 sounds per minute; the bed never stops, the pad dips under danger
music: 5 stems × 90 s loops + 3 zone overlays + 1 end cadence ≈ 9 min of generated audio
soft water-movement bed under all stems
+ bright choir-pad layer; filter opens (loop 60 s)
chloroplast owners: warm shimmer cue on entry
+ sub drone + bubbling percussive layer (loop 60 s)
stem key unchanged; low end +4 dB
low-pass + slow tremolo on the stem
cues pitch down a semitone while inside
ambient electronica (Boards of Canada, Tycho) · underwater pads (Abzû, Subnautica)
Music reacts to the ladder: yes
(one stem per stage, crossfaded on the stage change; each stem adds an instrument)
